'''ftp.decipher.com''' was Decipher's FTP host. The 1997 [[Star Wars CCG Palace]] Download Zone served client installers from this server.<ref name="dl">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/dialog/swccgpalace/downloadzone.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game: Dialog - Download Zone], Decipher (1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970607132924/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/dialog/swccgpalace/downloadzone.html Internet Archive]</ref> A web front end was captured in 2000.<ref name="ftp">[http://ftp.decipher.com/ ftp.decipher.com], Decipher (March 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000305004109/http://ftp.decipher.com/ Internet Archive]</ref>
